issues.where: crops L and Q along the upper-right and lower-right dark limb (also image-02.png crops C and E, image-06.png crops C and E)
issues.what: the atmosphere forms a doubled edge with a thin bright outer ring (including an unnatural pale violet highlight on the upper-right limb and a crisp orange line on the lower-right limb) separated by a dark gap from an inner hazy band, plus a grainy outer halo
issues.fix: replace the separate shell/rim composite with a single continuous volumetric scattering falloff across the limb with no hard outer ring, dark inner gap, or violet specular tint

issues.where: lower-left of crop A (also image-03.png crops P and Q, image-06.png crop A, image-07.png crop O)
issues.what: cloud bands radially pinch into a tight convergence knot on the lower-left lit hemisphere with visibly stretched linear streaks radiating toward the terminator
issues.fix: remap or paint out the spherical UV pole pinch using triplanar, cubed-sphere, or seamless flow-mapped cloud coordinates so cloud filaments do not stretch into a point

issues.where: crop P middle-right and bottom-left night-side clouds (also image-05.png and image-06.png crop E upper-left)
issues.what: blurry, airbrushed bluish-purple and magenta smudges sit over the dark clouds where sharp lightning filaments existed in the wider frame
issues.fix: remove the smeared purple/magenta blotches or render crisp, physically integrated internal cloud illumination and lightning at native resolution

issues.where: crops A, B, and I on the sunlit globe and polar vortex (also image-07.png crops K and O)
issues.what: cloud surfaces look slightly soft and upscaled at native 1:1 crop size in the closer shot, while sunlit cloud-top edges along the terminator show slight pixel stair-stepping
issues.fix: use a higher-resolution cloud texture/displacement map for the closer camera distance and anti-alias high-contrast terminator highlights

issues.where: crop H left-side Milky Way patch and crops B and D sunlit limb glare (also image-02.png crops B and D)
issues.what: the blue nebula patch on the left sky is soft and pixelated relative to overlaid point stars, and sharp 1-2 px stars shine undimmed right through the bright golden limb bloom
issues.fix: match the sky background map resolution to native render resolution and attenuate background stars inside bright atmospheric scattering and glare

issues.where: crop S outer glow transition into dark space (also image-04.png crop T)
issues.what: faint tonal banding steps appear where the warm atmospheric glow fades into the near-black sky
issues.fix: render and composite the atmospheric falloff in 16-bit/32-bit float and apply subtle blue-noise dithering before 8-bit output

issues.where: upper cloud fountain, also image-14.png tile B
issues.what: strands comb and stretch into linear fibers toward the convergence instead of breaking into eddies
issues.fix: ease the polar stretch and replace the combed flow with multi-scale turbulence

issues.where: left-limb dark rift and upper troughs, also image-14.png tiles B and H
issues.what: lightning sits on the cloud as painted purple-white strokes rather than light inside the volume
issues.fix: embed the discharge in the cloud so it scatters onto nearby faces

issues.where: tile D night-side limb, and the shadowed lower left of image-13.png
issues.what: shadowed clouds lose fine structure and read as airbrushed low-frequency tone
issues.fix: keep high-frequency cloud detail in the shadow and add a little scattered fill

issues.where: tile C, radial falloff above the sun, also the upper right of image-09.png
issues.what: faint concentric steps in the sun glow
issues.fix: dither the gradient and widen the falloff so the bands disappear
